messages:
anya: quick flag observed big cost swing in eu-west when preemptives reclaimed. the current per-route immediate penalty changes amplify oscillation. proposing a small allocator that does granular smoothing + capacity-aware normalization.
kevin: short question: how do we limit churn? frequent rebalances could be worse than the symptoms
anya: we gate rebalances with rebalance_min_interval and max_delta_per_rebalance. also use EMA smoothing over a 10m window to avoid reacting to spikes
maria: dedicated pools? we can't touch them automatically
anya: allocator only controls shared/dynamic pools. for dedicated we emit suggestions and a per-pool UI flag; infra makes the final call
suresh: can we get the exact knobs so sim/runtime teams can align?
anya: knobs: window=10m, smoothing=ema(alpha=0.18), normalize_by=[capacity_units,p95], rebalance_min_interval=90s, max_delta_per_rebalance=0.12, tenant_floor=tenant.min_penalty
kevin: ops alerts we need: allocator.rebalance_rate, suggested_vs_applied_penalty ratio, regional_p95_delta. rollback if p95 up >12% sustained 5m
deploy-bot: canary created: canary/penalty-allocator/4835001111 shadowing 1.5% traffic in eu-west
maria: add telemetry tag allocator_reason with values: capacity_norm|p95_adjust|tenant_floor. will help CS and SRE queries
anya: i'll write a short RFC with sim output and provide a deterministic replay artifact (replay.tar.gz) so runtime can reproduce decisions locally. plan: 2w shadow, then staged 25->50->100 with kill switch
suresh: include metric sample lines in RFC for alert rules authors
anya: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
